goal: Ensure decompressing oversized scripts always produces an unspendable script
Avoids leaving scripts spendable when decompressing into a reused destination buffer
agreement: Substantive support with testing across independent decodes (jcastros, fametrano, optout21)
Suggests throwing an error on oversized scripts instead of decoding as unspendable (sedited)
Questions whether the destination script could be cleared at the start of decompression (optout21)
